## Extreme weather definitions

```{r desc_age, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(magrittr) 

# Set directory
user <- 'claer14'
path3 <- paste0('C:/Users/', user, '/OneDrive - University of Cambridge/III. Research/Chapter 3 - Real time forecasts/')

# Load table
df <- read_excel(paste0(path3, "III. Tables/MT_base_desc.xlsx"))

# Section
df <- cbind(df[31:34, 1:2], df[35:38, 1:2])
names(df) <- make.unique(names(df))

# Create flextable
ft <- flextable(df) %>%
  fontsize(size = 12) %>%        # font size
  autofit()                      # automatically adjust column widths

# Use officer to center and scale
ft <- width(ft, j = 1:ncol(df), width = 10 / ncol(df))  # scale width to 80% of slide
ft
```
